name: openclaw_credit_risk_agent
description: OpenClaw multi-agent layer for Basel III/IFRS 9 Credit Risk & Expected Loss Assessment

tools.name: predict_pd
tools.description: Calculate Probability of Default using the regulatory WoE Logistic Scorecard or Challenger models.

tools.name: predict_lgd
tools.description: Calculate Loss Given Default using the two-stage hurdle recovery rate model.

tools.name: predict_ead
tools.description: Calculate Exposure at Default based on Credit Conversion Factor (CCF) and funded amount.

tools.name: calculate_expected_loss
tools.description: Calculate Expected Loss (EL = PD * LGD * EAD).

tools.name: run_full_credit_assessment
tools.description: Run end-to-end credit assessment returning PD, LGD, EAD, EL, score, risk grade, challenger comparison, SHAP drivers, and policy decision.

tools.name: explain_prediction
tools.description: Extract SHAP risk drivers and feature contributions for the applicant.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare predictions across Scorecard, XGBoost, Random Forest, and Challenger Logistic Regression.

tools.name: run_stress_test
tools.description: Apply macroeconomic shocks (-2% GDP, +5% unemployment) to quantify stressed PD and capital shortfall.

tools.name: calculate_psi
tools.description: Calculate Population Stability Index (PSI) to detect distribution drift.
